name: Thunderbird Park
note: Family adventure park on Tamborine Mountain (activities for children and adults), named by the Scenic Rim tourism board as a Tamborine stop.

name: Robert Sowter Park
note: Public park on Tamborine Mountain known for sunset views over the region, named by the Scenic Rim tourism board as a place to relax.

name: Curtis Falls
note: Waterfall reached by a rainforest walk on Tamborine Mountain, named by the Scenic Rim tourism board as one of the mountain's walks.

name: Gallery Walk
note: Street strip of galleries, cafes and artisan shops in the Tamborine Mountain village, named by the Scenic Rim tourism board as a stroll.

name: Cauldron Distillery
note: Gin distillery on Tamborine Mountain with tastings, named by the Scenic Rim tourism board.

name: Tamborine Mountain Distillery
note: Liqueur distillery and tasting venue on Tamborine Mountain, listed by the Scenic Rim tourism board as a stop to visit.

name: Tamborine Mountain Coffee Plantation
note: Coffee farm on Tamborine Mountain offering crop-to-cup tours, named by the Scenic Rim tourism board.

name: Tamborine Mountain Flower Farm
note: Gardens and open-air flower fields on Tamborine Mountain, listed in the Scenic Rim visitor directory; marginal, it is also a commercial accommodation-linked property.

name: Australian Outback Opals
note: Opal gallery and shop on Tamborine Mountain, listed by the Scenic Rim tourism board under galleries and shopping; marginal, a shop rather than a sight.

name: O'Reilly's Canungra Valley Vineyards
note: Vineyard and winery at Canungra with lawn and creek picnic setting, named by the Scenic Rim tourism board as a place to visit.

name: Mountview Alpaca Farm
note: Alpaca farm at Canungra where visitors meet the animals (paid alpaca experience), named by the Scenic Rim tourism board.

name: Scenic Rim Brewery
note: Brewery at Boonah with meals and views, named by the Scenic Rim tourism board as a food and drink stop.

name: Kooroomba Vineyard and Lavender Farm
note: Vineyard and lavender farm near Boonah with meals and mountain views, described by the Scenic Rim tourism board as a unique tourist destination.

name: Lake Moogerah
note: Lake and water-sports reservoir near Boonah with a camping ground, named by the Scenic Rim tourism board and Wikivoyage.

name: Lake Maroon
note: Reservoir near Boonah for paddling, fishing and camping, named by the Scenic Rim tourism board and Wikivoyage.

name: Mount Maroon
note: Mountain in Mount Maroon National Park near Boonah, climbed as a day walk, named by the Scenic Rim tourism board.

name: Moogerah Peaks National Park
note: National park of mountain peaks near Boonah and Lake Moogerah, named by Wikivoyage and the Scenic Rim tourism board as a walking destination.

name: The Lost World
note: Wilderness valley region of the Scenic Rim (Kerry Valley, Lost World, Lamington Gorge, Christmas Creek) with river swimming holes and a scenic tourist drive; a locality rather than one site, the Christmas Creek present in the app is part of it.

name: Tommerup's Dairy
note: Farm-based attraction in the Lost World, open by appointment or on open days, named by the Scenic Rim tourism board; marginal, visits are not always open.

name: The Overflow Estate 1895
note: Winery and restaurant set in a scenic estate near Beaudesert, named by the Scenic Rim tourism board.

name: Towri Sheep Cheesery
note: Sheep cheese farm near Beaudesert offering cheesemaking tours and tastings, named by the Scenic Rim tourism board.

name: Beaudesert Market
note: Market in Dick Westerman Park, Beaudesert, held on the first Saturday of the month only; a periodic market, judged out for the recurring-market rule unless the owner decides otherwise.

name: Summer Land Camels
note: Camel training centre and dairy near Harrisville where visitors meet the resident camels, named by the Scenic Rim tourism board as Australia's largest wild camel training centre.

name: Burleigh Heads Beach
note: Surf beach at Burleigh Heads, listed by Experience Gold Coast under beaches and waterways.

name: Rainbow Bay
note: Surf beach at Coolangatta, listed by Experience Gold Coast under beaches and waterways.

name: Kirra Beach
note: Surf beach at Coolangatta known for its surf school and surf club, named by Experience Gold Coast; marginal, named mainly through surf lessons.

name: The Spit
note: Sand spit and beach at Main Beach where the Broadwater meets the Gold Coast Seaway, listed by Experience Gold Coast under beaches and waterways.

name: The Coastal Markets Coolangatta
note: Market at Coolangatta, listed by Experience Gold Coast; a periodic market, judged out for the recurring-market rule unless its schedule is weekly and permanent.

name: Balter Brewing Company
note: Craft brewery on the Gold Coast with tasting and tours, listed by Experience Gold Coast; a venue, marginal as a standalone spot.

name: Wonder Reef Gold Coast
note: Operator-run attraction on the Northern Gold Coast, listed by Experience Gold Coast; the nature of the attraction is not stated in the source, so it needs research before judging.
